name: sample.txt
text: Northstar Logistics reported that delivery performance improved by 12 percent during the first half of the year. The company reduced average shipment delays from 4.2 days to 3.1 days after introducing route planning software. Fuel costs rose by 7 percent, creating pressure on operating margins. Management approved an investment of 2 million dollars for warehouse automation. The rollout will begin in October and finish by March. The operations team recommends tracking delivery times weekly and reviewing safety incidents monthly. Executives said the project should reduce repetitive work, improve inventory accuracy, and protect customer service quality. Regional managers will submit progress reports at the end of each month. The company plans to assess results after six months and decide whether to expand the program to additional facilities.
